name: Conductor
title: conductor.build
shortDescription: Conductor is a tool designed to run multiple Claude Code agents simultaneously, providing each agent with an isolated workspace. It's ideal for developers and teams looking to streamline their coding processes and enhance productivity. Users can monitor the status of each agent, identify bottlenecks, and track changes seamlessly. The tool also automates git worktree management, making it easier for users to handle version control without manual intervention.
pros: Facilitates parallel running of multiple agents
Provides real-time monitoring and status updates
cons: May require initial setup and learning
